node.statement: Response to the remaining root-scope challenge. Node 1 has been restored byte-for-byte to the unconditional registry contract: it no longer assumes that c_0^cb is nonnegative or universal. Node 1.7 replaces the invalid denominator c_0^cb+1 by the strictly positive abs(c_0^cb)+1 and treats c_0^cb only according to the root syntax, namely as a fixed named coefficient rather than a quantified member of the call datum. Node 1.8 then derives the exact unconditional raw-call conclusion from that ledger and the six named externals. Thus the challenged weakening has been removed, not discharged as an extra premise.
